# Merging forms

`merged` reads two forms that both have `size`. The later form in its `inputsId` wins.

<Inputs id="defaults">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: color
    type: string
    description: Favorite color
    default: blue
  - name: size
    type: string
    description: T-shirt size
    default: medium
```
</Inputs>

<Inputs id="overrides">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: size
    type: string
    description: T-shirt size, which wins
    default: large
```
</Inputs>

<Command
  id="merged"
  inputsId={["defaults", "overrides"]}
  env={{ COLOR: "{{ .inputs.color }}", SIZE: "{{ .inputs.size }}" }}
  outputs={["picked"]}
  command={`echo "picked=$COLOR/$SIZE" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>
